zoning.notes: Maximize planting area while preserving circulation and seating nodes.
Use pathways, seating platforms and structural edges to define flow.
Reserve space for service areas, irrigation equipment and storage.

Tropical Modernism.palette: Vibrant greens with warm earth tones and accent flowering plants

Zen Minimalist.palette: Monochrome greens with muted foliage and subtle texture

Indian Courtyard.palette: Lush greens with seasonal flowering accents and terracotta highlights

English Cottage.palette: Soft pastels, textured foliage and layered flowering clusters

Mediterranean.palette: Silver-gray foliage with bold floral accents and sunbaked stone

color_palettes.name: Monochromatic Green
color_palettes.notes: Layer textured foliage in varying greens for calm sophistication.

color_palettes.name: Vibrant Tropical
color_palettes.notes: Combine yellow, orange, magenta and deep green for high-energy landscapes.

color_palettes.name: Textured Foliage
color_palettes.notes: Balance silver, burgundy and chartreuse leaves with minimal bloom color.

layout_rules.rule: Place the main focal specimen tree toward the north-east or centre of the garden for visual depth.
Keep circulation pathways open and avoid forcing movement through dense planting.
Use hardscape edges to separate service areas from softscape zones.
Position water features near seating areas and reflective surfaces for maximum impact.
Group plants by height with taller canopy elements at the back and groundcovers in the front.
